label: Given the source’s possible first contingent C and reported causal default, A10C attributes a…
paraphrase: Given the source’s possible first contingent C and reported causal default, A10C attributes a prima-facie reason to think C would have a cause. It excludes a contingent cause by C’s firstness and says that, if C has a cause, that cause is a Necessary Being. It concludes only an apparent prima-facie reason for the possibility of something caused by a Necessary Being, not a deductively established possible cause, actual existential support or actual Necessary Being.
